gate_rule.description: dominant script is not Latin and its share of letters is at least 0.5

reproduction.method: real sentinel.fusion.fuse() with FUSION_RULES temporarily set to the dump-time baseline (temperature 1.0, scam weight 1.0, unwanted weight 0.5)
reproduction.note: The dumped fused_level is the pre-calibration baseline recorded in calibrate.BASELINE_PARAMS and calibration.md (temperature 1.0, scam weight 1.0). The shipped rules.json is the calibrated candidate (temperature 3.0, scam weight 0.9), so replaying the shipped parameters against the dump is expected to differ and is reported only for transparency.

shipped_rules.decision_basis: real sentinel.fusion.fuse() with sentinel/data/rules.json as shipped (temperature 3.0, scam weight 0.9)
shipped_rules.variant_method: V1 to V4 are the same variant definitions applied on top of the shipped rules; V4 temperature-scaled p_scam uses the shipped temperature

cross_check.note: There is no stored shipped-level column. dump_20261108.csv fused_level is the pre-calibration baseline. The shipped levels are recomputed with calibrate.risk_and_level and the chosen candidate (temperature 3.0, scam weight 0.9), exactly as tests/test_calibration_shipped.py does.
cross_check.reference_scope: tests/test_calibration_shipped.py and calibration.md cover all 13,104 dumped rows; this run joins the 13,098 held-out rows.
cross_check.docs_benchmarks_note: docs/benchmarks.md section SMS fusion calibration reports the 6,550-row test half only; the shipped V0 numbers here are over all 13,098 joined rows and are not directly comparable.

shipped_rules.best_variant_rule: highest gated risky recall among the variants whose gated ham FPR is at most 5%, then lower gated ham FPR

synthetic_false.note: heldout_20261107.csv synthetic values are 'true' and 'mixed'; there are no 'false' rows
